info.description: Backend for the Fit Fueler mobile app: workouts, meals, water and analytics.
info.title: Fit Fueler API

post.description: Reserved for Sign in with Apple. Currently always returns 501.
post.summary: Sign in with Apple (not available yet)

post.description: Signs in (or creates) a user by email without any provider. Only registered when DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true, which is refused in production.
Verifies a Google ID token and returns an access/refresh token pair. The account is created on first sign-in (is_new_user = true).

parameters.description: Google ID token and device details
parameters.name: body

post.description: Revokes the session that the refresh token belongs to. Always returns 204.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh pair. The old refresh token stops working. Reusing an old token revokes the whole session.

get.description: Searches the shared catalog and the user's own custom exercises. Results are ordered by relevance (exact name, prefix, shorter names). has_more tells the app whether to load another page.

parameters.description: Language code of the name, e.g. en (default: any)
parameters.name: language

post.description: Adds an exercise only the current user can see. met_value is estimated from the category and name when omitted. Names are unique per user (409 exercise_exists).

get.description: Categories visible to the user, with the number of exercises in each.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the user's own custom exercise. Logged workouts keep their own copy of the exercise name.

patch.description: Partial update of the user's own custom exercise. Catalog exercises are read-only (403 exercise_read_only).

get.description: Returns the account of the authenticated user.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the account, scrubs personal fields (email, name, provider IDs, profile details) and revokes all sessions. Remaining logs stay anonymous. Full purge is handled outside the API on request.

get.description: Returns the goals that apply today. 404 goals_not_set until the profile is complete or goals are set manually.

put.description: Stores goals chosen by the user, effective from today. Earlier days keep the goals that applied then. Profile changes no longer overwrite them.

post.description: Replaces today's goals with defaults computed from the profile and latest weight. Needs a complete profile (422 profile_incomplete otherwise).

get.description: Returns the profile with the current weight (latest entry), age, units, timezone and whether the profile is complete.

patch.description: Partial update: omitted fields stay unchanged. weight_kg adds a weight entry dated today. When the profile is complete and the user has not set their own goals, suggested goals are recalculated.

get.description: Entries between two local dates, newest first. Defaults to the last 90 days. At most 500 entries and a 2-year range.

post.description: Records a weight. The date defaults to today in the user's timezone; pass local_date to backfill. Suggested goals are recalculated.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an entry and recalculates suggested goals.

post.description: Adds an exercise to the user's workout for a local date (default today), creating the workout if needed. Omitted duration_min and calories_burned are estimated (flags duration_estimated / calories_estimated). Send an Idempotency-Key header (a UUID generated once per submit) so a retried request cannot create a duplicate: a replay returns the existing entry with 200.

parameters.description: UUID generated by the client for this submit
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key

delete.description: Soft-deletes the entry. A workout left without entries is deleted as well.

patch.description: Partial update. Changing sets re-estimates an estimated duration, and a changed duration re-estimates estimated calories. Values you send are kept as given.

get.description: Workouts with their entries and totals between two local dates, newest first. Both dates default to today in the user's timezone. At most 200 workouts and a 366-day range.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the workout and all of its entries.

patch.description: Partial update of the name and notes. An empty string clears the field.

language.description: Language is the language of the name as a code like "en" (default "en").

met_value.description: MetValue is optional. When omitted it is estimated from the category and name.

attribution.description: Attribution is present for catalog exercises only.

message.example: The sign-in token could not be verified

profile_completed.description: ProfileCompleted is true once sex, birth date, height and a weight entry exist.

calories_estimated.description: CaloriesEstimated is true when the server calculated the calories (MET x weight x time).

duration_estimated.description: DurationEstimated is true when the server estimated the duration from the number of sets.

weight_kg.description: WeightKG is absent for bodyweight exercises.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
